nodes.label: Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) System
nodes.author: Aygün, E. et al.
nodes.rationale: LLM-driven tree search system for creating empirical software; systematically improves quality metrics through intelligent code mutations

nodes.label: Tree Search Algorithm for Code Optimization
nodes.rationale: Maintains diverse candidate tree; backtracks when specific mutations plateau; discovers strategies leading to abrupt score jumps

nodes.label: scRNA-seq Batch Integration Task
nodes.rationale: ERA discovered 40 novel methods outperforming top human-developed methods; BBKNN (TS) achieved 14% improvement over best published method

nodes.label: COVID-19 Hospitalization Forecasting
nodes.rationale: ERA generated 14 models outperforming CDC ensemble; average WIS of 26 vs ensemble's 29; recombination models showed synergistic hybridization

nodes.label: Time Series Forecasting (GIFT-Eval)
nodes.rationale: Per-dataset solution outperformed May 2025 leaderboard; unified solution created general-purpose library with adaptive configuration system

nodes.label: Research Idea Injection Mechanism
nodes.rationale: LLM integrates ideas from papers, textbooks, search results; enables systematic exploration of research idea space; 44% of recombinations outperformed base methods

nodes.label: LLM-Driven Code Mutation
nodes.rationale: Semantic-aware rewrites produce complex meaningful variations; more flexible than random mutations in genetic programming

nodes.label: Empirical Software as Optimization Problem
nodes.rationale: Converts software creation into search for program maximizing quality score; enables systematic exploration of solution space

nodes.label: Systematic Idea Recombination
nodes.rationale: Programmatic generation of method combinations; 44% of recombinations outperformed base methods; mirrors scientific practice of combining ideas

nodes.label: ERA: Empirical Research Agent
nodes.author: Google Research
nodes.rationale: Tree search algorithm for code generation and optimization, combining LLM-based code mutation with PUCT exploration strategy to solve scientific problems through iterative refinement.

nodes.label: PUCT Tree Search Algorithm
nodes.rationale: Polynomial Upper Confidence Trees applied to code search space; balances exploitation of high-scoring solutions with exploration via acquisition score PUCTi = ri + cpuct·E(i).

nodes.label: Code Mutation System
nodes.rationale: LLM generates novel code variants conditioned on parent node; mutations occur at code level with ideas embedded in prompts; scored empirically and backpropagated through tree.

nodes.label: Research Idea Injection
nodes.rationale: Emulates expert behavior by injecting research instructions from literature into prompts; uses LLM summaries of papers or AI-assisted literature search to guide code generation.

nodes.label: Method Recombination
nodes.rationale: Combines top-performing methods by prompting LLM to compare and explain technical similarities/differences, then instructs tree search to recombine best parts; differs from prior work by operating in conceptual space via prompts rather than distilled model space.

nodes.label: scRNA-seq Batch Integration Task
nodes.rationale: Removes batch effects while retaining biological variability; evaluated on OpenProblems benchmark v2.0.030 with 13 metrics across 6 datasets; ERA achieved 0.6671 overall score vs 0.6740 for GPT-5 Best-of-N.

nodes.label: COVID-19 Hospitalization Forecasting
nodes.rationale: Predicts weekly hospital admissions across 52 jurisdictions; rolling validation window; ERA models outperformed CovidHub-ensemble on majority of locations; 14 recombined strategies exceeded ensemble baseline.

nodes.label: GIFT-Eval Time Series Forecasting
nodes.rationale: General time series forecasting across 97 datasets; unified solution with 8 preset configurations; final MASE of 0.734 achieved through iterative refinement with holidays library integration.
